$comment: Golden vectors for the research formulas (docs/formulas/research.md).
The cost table is verified byte-for-byte against rglTechCost at 10d8:1d4e.
The worked cases come from the Exodus fixture, where the original engine's
own accounting shows exactly what each level cost.

tech_level_cost.$comment: cost = sum(levels)*10 + rglTechCost[level], then the per-field setting, then slow tech.

cases.why: Exodus player 5 took Weapons 10->11 for exactly this, cheap field
the same base cost at the normal setting
level 1 from nothing is the bare table entry
the added cost is 10 per level already held, across all fields

generalized_research.$comment: Half the budget to the primary field, 15% of the budget to each of the other five.

cases.why: half of 1000 to the primary field
